findings.defect: Thin toe fins and web ends after open slot conversion
findings.evidence: Iso at the toe edge; wish thickness reports25.2,14.4 and9.9mm2 wall regions
findings.repair: Redesign the claw seats to avoid tapered residual toe membranes while retaining the paw proportions and three claws.

observation: The ankle buttress now removes the unsupported ledge. Top/iso show the rectangular toe slots leaving sharp thin outer fins and thin curved web ends; the wall gate confirms three remaining regions.
